panels.description: RO permeate and RO reject (m³) for yesterday, from the flow totalizers (302-FIT-02, 302-FIT-01): last reading minus first reading of the IST day, ignoring readings of 0. The 30-day average is of RO permeate. Always the last 30 complete days, whatever range is selected.

targets.query: SELECT last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") AS "RO permeate", last("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer") AS "RO reject" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer" > 0 AND "302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)

SELECT mean("p") AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM (SELECT last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") AS "p" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none))

panels.title: RO permeate yesterday

panels.description: Inlet flow (m³/day) from the inlet totalizer (100-FIT-01). Design capacity 250 m³/day. Always the last 30 complete days, whatever range is selected.

targets.query: SELECT last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") - first("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS "Yesterday", 100 * (last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") - first("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer")) / 250 AS "% of design" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)

SELECT mean("i") AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM (SELECT last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") - first("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS "i" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none))

panels.title: Inlet treated yesterday

panels.description: RO permeate ÷ (RO permeate + RO reject). Target ≥ 98 %: green at or above, amber below. Always the last 30 complete days, whatever range is selected.

targets.query: SELECT 100 * (last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer")) / ((last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer")) + (last("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer"))) AS "RO recovery" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer" > 0 AND "302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)

SELECT mean("x") AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM (SELECT 100 * (last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer")) / ((last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer")) + (last("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer") - first("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer"))) AS "x" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer" > 0 AND "302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none))

panels.title: RO recovery yesterday

panels.description: Plant energy (900-MFM-01) ÷ inlet treated (kWh per m³ of inlet). Always the last 30 complete days, whatever range is selected.

targets.query: SELECT (last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") - first("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total")) / (last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") - first("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer")) AS "Yesterday" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total" > 0 AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)

SELECT mean("x") AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM (SELECT (last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") - first("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total")) / (last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") - first("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer")) AS "x" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total" > 0 AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none))

panels.title: Specific energy yesterday

panels.description: Treated outflow (m³/day) from gsi_ahspa_stats. Design capacity 30,000 m³/day. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; before the morning statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT daily_flow_out FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL)) AS "Latest day", (SELECT 100 * daily_flow_out / 30000 FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL)) AS "% of design", (SELECT avg(daily_flow_out) FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30) AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) AS "⌀ 30 days"

panels.title: Treated outflow · latest day

panels.description: Plant energy ÷ treated outflow (kWh/m³). Days above twice the 30-day median (implausible) are left out. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; before the morning statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: WITH e AS (SELECT "Date", daily_power / NULLIF(daily_flow_out, 0) AS se FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30) AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_power > 0 AND daily_flow_out > 0), m AS (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY se) AS med FROM e) SELECT (SELECT se FROM e WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL) AND se <= 2 * (SELECT med FROM m)) AS "Latest day", (SELECT avg(se) FROM e WHERE se <= 2 * (SELECT med FROM m)) AS "⌀ 30 days"

panels.description: Inlet to outlet COD, % removed (lab averages). Target ≥ 80 %, from the existing lab dashboard. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; before the morning statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT 100 * (daily_cod_avg_inlet - daily_cod_avg_outlet) / NULLIF(daily_cod_avg_inlet, 0) FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL)) AS "Latest day", (SELECT avg(100 * (daily_cod_avg_inlet - daily_cod_avg_outlet) / NULLIF(daily_cod_avg_inlet, 0)) FROM gsi_ahspa_stats WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30) AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) AS "⌀ 30 days"

panels.title: Specific energy · latest day

panels.description: Online COD analyser, treated water tank (AIT-30103A), daily average. No limit set yet. A reading that has not changed for 30 days is marked for checking. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; before the morning statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: WITH w AS (SELECT min(daily_avg_outlet_cod) AS mn, max(daily_avg_outlet_cod) AS mx, count(daily_avg_outlet_cod) AS n, avg(daily_avg_outlet_cod) AS av FROM gsi_nandedmbr_stats WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30) AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) SELECT (SELECT round(daily_avg_outlet_cod::numeric, 1) || ' mg/L' || CASE WHEN w.n >= 7 AND w.mn = w.mx THEN ' · constant 30 days' ELSE '' END FROM gsi_nandedmbr_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_nandedmbr_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_permeate_flow IS NOT NULL)) AS "Latest day", w.av AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM w

panels.title: Treated TSS · latest day

panels.description: Permeate from the flow meter (10-minute averages summed; the totalizer is faulty). Days with less than 80 % of readings are left out. Design 1,500 m³/day.

targets.query: SELECT last(m3) AS "Latest day", last(m3) / 15 AS "% of design", mean(m3) AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM (SELECT sum(v) / 2 AS m3, last(e) - first(e) AS kwh, count(v) AS n FROM (SELECT mean("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS v, last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") AS e FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(30m) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)) WHERE time < now() - 1d AND n >= 38

SELECT last(m3) AS "x" FROM (SELECT sum(v) / 2 AS m3, last(e) - first(e) AS kwh, count(v) AS n FROM (SELECT mean("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS v, last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") AS e FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(30m) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)) WHERE time < now() - 1d AND n >= 38

SELECT last(se) AS "x" FROM (SELECT kwh / m3 AS se FROM (SELECT sum(v) / 2 AS m3, last(e) - first(e) AS kwh, count(v) AS n FROM (SELECT mean("202_fit_03_mbr_permeate_flow") AS v, last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") AS e FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(30m) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 32d GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)) WHERE time < now() - 1d AND n >= 38 AND m3 > 20)

panels.description: Latest lab COD at Treated Wastewater and the 30-day average.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 191 AND btrim(l.location) = 'Treated Wastewater' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD' AND l.time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '31 days' AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1) SELECT (SELECT v FROM d ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Latest", avg(v) AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM d

WITH d AS (SELECT (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 191 AND btrim(l.location) = 'Treated Wastewater' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD' AND l.time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '31 days' AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1) SELECT to_char(max(day), 'DD Mon') || CASE WHEN max(day) < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) THEN '|old' ELSE '' END AS "Day" FROM d

panels.description: RO permeate volume on the latest complete day, from the RO permeate flow meter. Shows "RO not running" when below 10 m³.

targets.query: SELECT last(m3) AS "Latest day" FROM (SELECT sum(v) / 2 AS m3 FROM (SELECT mean("302_fit_03_ro_permeate_flow") AS v FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 3d GROUP BY time(10m) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 3d AND v > 1 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(0)) WHERE time < now() - 1d

SELECT last(m3) AS "x" FROM (SELECT sum(v) / 2 AS m3 FROM (SELECT mean("302_fit_03_ro_permeate_flow") AS v FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 3d GROUP BY time(10m) fill(none)) WHERE time > now() - 3d AND v > 1 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(0)) WHERE time < now() - 1d

panels.title: RO permeate · latest day
